strings.zh: 呀啊呼！北面的口袋竞技场{NEWLINE}马上就要开业了,{CLEAR}我和我的精灵已经迫不及待地{CLEAR}准备去那里大展身手了。
strings.en: Yahoo! The Pokéathlon Dome up north is{NEWLINE}opening soon!{SCROLL}My Pokémon and I can’t wait to go show{NEWLINE}them what we’ve got.

strings.zh: 满金市北面的自然公园{NEWLINE}是非常适合情侣约会的地方。{CLEAR}经常可以看到有年轻人{CLEAR}成双成对地出现在那里。
strings.en: The National Park north of Goldenrod{NEWLINE}City is the perfect place for a date.{SCROLL}You often see young couples there.

strings.zh: 最近北面的口袋竞技场{NEWLINE}重新装修开业,{CLEAR}因此吸引来了不少训练家。
strings.en: The Pokéathlon Dome up north{NEWLINE}reopened after a renovation recently,{CLEAR}and it’s drawing lots of Trainers.

strings.zh: 从这里向北就可以到达缘朱市了。
strings.en: Head north from here and you’ll reach{NEWLINE}Ecruteak City.

strings.zh: 你已经逛过满金市了吗？{NEWLINE}那里有好多好玩的东西呢！
strings.en: Have you looked around Goldenrod City{NEWLINE}yet? There’s so much fun stuff there!

strings.zh: 我朋友在３１号道路。{SCROLL}……啊！对了,{NEWLINE}有一棵奇怪的树{CLEAR}堵住了去路。{CLEAR}不知现在能否通过了？
strings.en: My friend is on Route 31.{SCROLL}Oh, yeah.{NEWLINE}There was a weird tree{CLEAR}blocking the road.{CLEAR}I wonder if it’s been cleared?

strings.zh: 谢谢你替我送信！{SCROLL}诶？你说我在装忙？{NEWLINE}嗯,对不起{CLEAR}其实我是能走开的。{SCROLL}我利用了你的好意,{NEWLINE}为表歉意,{CLEAR}这个送给你。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Thanks for delivering my letter!{SCROLL}Huh? You say I was only pretending{NEWLINE}to be busy?{SCROLL}Um, sorry. I could have gone myself.{SCROLL}I took advantage of your kindness,{NEWLINE}so please take this as an apology.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我的朋友在睡觉吧？{NEWLINE}总是在睡觉呢！
strings.en: My pal was snoozing, right?{NEWLINE}Heh, he’s always sleeping.

strings.zh: 诶！！{NEWLINE}邮件丢了？{CLEAR}是么？太遗憾了。{CLEAR}也没办法啊。
strings.en: What?!{NEWLINE}You lost the Mail?{CLEAR}Oh, well. That’s OK.{CLEAR}Don’t worry about it.

strings.zh: 听说有跟它说话就会蠕动的树{NEWLINE}把路给堵住了,{SCROLL}听说用杰尼龟喷壶对它洒水,{NEWLINE}还大闹起来了呢。
strings.en: A strange tree is blocking the road.{NEWLINE}It wriggles around if you talk to it.{SCROLL}I heard it became wild when someone{NEWLINE}watered it with a Squirt Bottle.

strings.zh: 我喜欢广播放的{NEWLINE}精灵的摇篮曲呢。
strings.en: I like the Pokémon Lullaby they play{NEWLINE}on the radio.

strings.zh: 咦呀~对了,{NEWLINE}只要这样手机{CLEAR}就变成广播了,{CLEAR}这真是跟做梦一样啊！{SCROLL}嗯？你的手机{NEWLINE}还没有变成广播？{CLEAR}那太浪费哩~{SCROLL}广播塔的１层前台{NEWLINE}现在在做测试吧？{CLEAR}全部答对了的话,{CLEAR}可以拿到收音机！{SCROLL}趁还没结束,{NEWLINE}你也赶紧去拿吧！
strings.en: I can’t believe such a tiny change{NEWLINE}turns the Pokégear into a radio!{SCROLL}Oh, your Pokégear doesn’t have{NEWLINE}that feature yet?{SCROLL}It’s a shame!{SCROLL}They happen to give quizzes at the{NEWLINE}Radio Tower reception on the{CLEAR}first floor.{SCROLL}If you can answer them correctly,{NEWLINE}they’ll give you the Radio Card!{SCROLL}You better try it while they{NEWLINE}have some left!

strings.zh: 别看我这样,大婶我{NEWLINE}对机械可是很精通哦。{SCROLL}要不要教给你{NEWLINE}广播的听法啊？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I may not look it, but I’m pretty good{NEWLINE}at mechanics.{SCROLL}Do you want to know how to{NEWLINE}listen to the radio? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 打开手机后,{NEWLINE}就要按下广播的按钮。{SCROLL}之后调频画面{NEWLINE}就会出现了。{SCROLL}画面正中有频道图,{CLEAR}去调上面一闪一闪的标记{CLEAR}来换频道,{CLEAR}就可以收听{CLEAR}各种节目了。{SCROLL}要是嫌麻烦,{NEWLINE}用频道图旁边的{CLEAR}４个按钮{CLEAR}也可以方便地选节目哦！
strings.en: You open your Pokégear and press the{NEWLINE}radio button. Then you see the screen{CLEAR}for tuning in a signal.{SCROLL}The middle of the screen is the{NEWLINE}radio-reception map.{SCROLL}You can move the blinking mark on the{NEWLINE}map around to tune in to different{CLEAR}radio shows.{SCROLL}For those who think this is a pain,{NEWLINE}there are four channels, two on each{CLEAR}side, for easy tuning.
Was I being a backseat driver?
